lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs4Cu4Br8 (reduced formula CsCuBr2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Fmm2 (No. 143), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers in octahedral environments coordinated by six Br neighbors, while Cs centers have eight Br neighbors; the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-sharing between Cu octahedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Cs and Cu polyhedra, with edge-sharing also observed among Cs polyhedra.
